notes.title: Small Hotfix (May 02, 2021)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Today we are pushing some small hotfixes for the game.

[list][*]-Attempted to fix an issue where sometimes the host wouldn't load into the game correctly.
[*]-Attempted to fix some various in-game crashes.
[*]-Attempted to fix an issue where some players were occasionally stuck on a black screen on launch
[/list]

If you are still experiencing these issues (or any others) please let us know on our Discord - you can join by clicking the button in the top right hand corner of the main game menu.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Today we are releasing a small update to address some bugs and add an extra lobby setting.

[list]
[*]-Added Blood Test Success Rate option - this allows the lobby host to change the success chance of the Blood Test
[*]-Fixed an issue where settings weren't saving correctly.
[*]-Fixed an issue where the 'You were killed by...' notification displayed the wrong icon.
[*]-Fixed some issues where games were in a broken state.
[/list]

If you have any feedback or are experiencing bugs, please join us on the Discord and let us know!
https://discord.gg/t28uepVnm3

Enjoy everyone!

notes.title: Minor Post-Release Patch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have pushed a small hotfix for the game post-release.

-Added 'How To Play' menu to the game. This will give players a much better understanding of how the game works, what the job of each role is, and so on. This menu was already accessible from within a game but now you can see it on the main menu.

-Removed some debugging hotkeys.

Enjoy everyone! Remember, if you are struggling to find games, you can try to find players on our Discord!
